title: Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc. to Present at NAREIT’s REITWeek 2012 Investor Conference
summary: Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc. today announced that executives from its senior business management team Inland American Business Manager Advisor, Inc., will be speaking at REITWeek 2012 (r) : NAREIT's Investor Forum. The presentation is scheduled for 4:30 p.m. ET on Tuesday, June 12. Approximately 2,000 institutional investors, investment banking professionals and other REIT management teams will be attending the conference. The Inland American executives will provide insight into the REITs business structure, latest company developments and diverse portfolio of nationwide commercial real estate including retail, multi-family, industrial, lodging, office and student housing properties. REITWeek 2012: NAREIT's Investor Forum will take place June 12-14 at the Hilton New York located at 1335 Avenue of the Americas, New York City. About Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc.
